$comment: Golden fixture for openspec change replace-observation-with-sightings,
tasks.md 4.13 / galaxy-view spec.md 'A Galaxy Link's Id Is Its Lane's
Stable Id' — 'A cross-stack fixture pins the equality under the
Go-sole-authority regime'.
Pins that galaxy.LaneIdBetween(aSystemId, bSystemId) — the derivation a
gate-attachment write (charts.GateAttachmentWrite), a gate body's served
laneId (system.LaneGate.LaneId), and the fleet DTO's served laneId all
share — agrees with the STORED Lane.Id the generator itself assigns via
the independent laneIdFor(cell,cell)/SystemIdFor(cell) pair
(backend/galaxy/field.go). These are two different code paths over the
same unordered system-id pair; nothing enforces they stay in sync except
this fixture.
Governed by cross-stack-determinism's Go-sole-authority regime:
backend/galaxy has no TypeScript mirror (mirror-map.json here runs in
anti-mirror mode, matching fixtures/space and fixtures/fleet), so this
family is asserted only across the Go build-target matrix.
Case provenance:
- ordinaryLane_adjacentPositiveCoordinates / negativeCoordinateEndpoint:
hand-picked Cell pairs; wantLaneId computed from laneIdFor's
documented format ("lane_%d_%d_%d_%d", ordered by the lexicographically
smaller (X,Y) endpoint first) and confirmed against the running
LaneIdBetween at fixture-authoring time.
- bridgeLane: a REAL bridge lane discovered from the deterministic
NewField(3, voidParams()) fixture field_test.go's own
TestField_BridgeConstruction exercises (same seed, same params) —
not a hand-picked pair. lane_id_stable_fixture_test.go's own
TestLaneIdBetween_Scenario_BridgeCaseIsARealBridgeLane re-derives it
from that live field and cross-checks Bridge==true and the id
against this case, so a generator change that moves or removes this
specific bridge fails loud rather than leaving a stale case unnoticed.
- sameCrossing_orderA / sameCrossing_orderB_swapped: the SAME crossing
as ordinaryLane_adjacentPositiveCoordinates, endpoints swapped —
both orderings of one pair must yield the same id.
- unparseableEndpoint_collapsesToZeroCell: SDET-added boundary probe,
not a scenario this task fixes — tasks.md 4.13 flags
LaneIdBetween("bogus", "sys_5_5") == "lane_0_0_5_5" as a silent
landmine (an unparseable system id collapses to the zero Cell rather
than erroring, which COULD collide with a real crossing at (0,0)-
(5,5)). Pinned here as documented, deliberate current behavior — not
an assertion that it is correct — so a future change to this
fallback is a visible decision, not a silent diff.

laneIdEquality.name: unparseableEndpoint_collapsesToZeroCell
